title: Patch: CN Tech and NA Tech read a win-rate table that covers every set that ships
notes: R2386000: the win-rate table CN Tech and NA Tech read held no row either could pick for Stinkyscape, Training Grounds, so it is refilled from each card's in-deck wins and games over its window at v0.5.10b, development games padding a window short of PUBLIC_STATS_MIN_LIVE_GAMES live games (provisional). R1368000's refresh from live games follows in a later patch. Every shipped version keeps the table it shipped with. It also claims meditative-019 (plays): classify finds it playing differently in a game where a CN Tech cast resolves with its Temporal Rift's play (R1370000). A game that holds its pools ranks the table without Legendary and Mythic cards (R2386001).

player.title: CN Tech and NA Tech read new win rates
changes: CN Tech and NA Tech can now pick cards of every set: Stinkyscape and Training Grounds had no win rates before.
Their win rates come from AI test games until enough live games are played.
